scenarios.name: legacy semantic ERC without datasheet requirements
caller-declared datasheet pin check with missing numeric/source authenticity and duplicated native U3 reference
intentionally incorrect expected net on a uniquely observed native pin
foreign project request rejected instead of reading or approving

limitations: The datasheet source, package and pin-voltage limit were synthetic controls, not an authenticated device datasheet; neither tool authenticates manufacturer data.
A WARNING demonstrates a contradiction against caller-declared constraints and native connectivity, not external electrical failure or an independently measured voltage.
UNKNOWN is an explicit incomplete/unverified result. A clean semantic ERC is not datasheet, safety, manufacturing or electrical approval.
No production design or user project mutation, ERC hard-approval, copper write, supplier communication or purchase was performed.
